notes.title: Welcome to Pumpkinidad Island! -- Free Halloween Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5213421/83dc7edfc159bd4772886dd6854e48c6a36fd97a.jpg[/img]

[b]Trick or treat![/b]
No need to ask twice on this one - that's why we're treating you to a brand new, free Halloween update for [b]Bridge Constructor[/b]. Five new, spooky and eerily exciting levels are awaiting players on [b]"Pumpkinidad Island"[/b].

Seeing as it's Halloween, we can't go without some haunted castles, bats and cemeteries. Build bridges over seemingly endless valleys in the deepest, foggiest night, with a full moon hanging above. Make sure to build them strong enough for the heavy [b]Coach of the Dead[/b] to be able to get across.
